evaluation_scope: Visible answer against the four supplied rubric dimensions and supplied fictional facts.

dimensions.name: Consistent naming and whole-dataset scope
evidence: We assemble a fixed post-training dataset D from compiled environmental observations.
Appendix C reports the composition of the full post-training dataset D.
Composition of the post-training dataset D, including the training and validation subsets and rejected records retained for audit.
dimensions.assessment: The intended term is used in the body, appendix reference, and caption. The anaphoric wording 'The dataset' is consistent. Misleading training-buffer and learning-reservoir labels are removed, and D retains its whole-collection scope.

dimensions.name: Scope, partition timing, and legacy identifier
evidence: Before fitting, we partition its eligible records into training and validation subsets.
The dataset also retains rejected records for audit; these records are used for neither fitting nor validation.
The term post-training dataset identifies the fixed collection without implying queueing, eviction, or experience replay.
dimensions.assessment: Eligible-record partitioning precedes fitting; training, validation, and audit-only scope remain distinct; the exact legacy identifier is preserved. No queue, eviction, or replay operation is introduced for D.

dimensions.name: Actual input-buffer behavior
evidence: The input buffer holds up to 32 incoming measurements until processing.
Acquisition pauses when the buffer is full and resumes when capacity becomes available.
Input buffer is the appropriate term for this bounded memory queue, so the passage is retained unchanged.
dimensions.assessment: The B body is verbatim unchanged and preserves capacity, pending-processing storage, removal, pause, and resume. Buffer is retained for the actual queue and no experience replay is implied.

dimensions.name: Requested scope and prose convention
evidence: Separate A and B headings contain connected paragraphs, with a caption under A and naming reasons for both objects.
It describes temporary storage while measurements await processing and is distinct from the fixed research dataset in A.
The B body matches the supplied draft exactly.
dimensions.assessment: The answer explains the difference through the supplied objects, preserves the already clear B passage, and stays within writing revision. It uses no explanatory colons or sentence-interrupting dashes. The lexical hyphen in post-training is consistent with the request.

optional_preferences.preference: Shorten the naming reasons by reducing repeated references to experience replay.
optional_preferences.reason: The existing reasons remain short paragraphs and agree with the supplied facts; their length does not establish a rubric violation.
